motion.name: review-duration

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Green action with clear focus and a small control radius.
components.css: .ds-primary { font: 550 15px InterVariable, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--green); color: var(--white); min-height: 50px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--green-hover); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .65; cursor: wait; }

components.name: Copy control
components.description: Outlined secondary action for optional command blocks.
components.css: .ds-copy { font: 400 13px InterVariable, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink); background: transparent; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 4px; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-copy:hover { background: var(--selected); color: var(--green); } .ds-copy:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Evidence citation
components.description: Real fragment navigation to a source passage, not an ornamental timestamp.
components.html:
5:00

Synthetic source: include the tenant ID in the cache key.
components.css: .ds-citation { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 0 5px; font: 500 13px monospace; color: var(--green); background: #eaf0ed; border-radius: 3px; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-citation:hover { color: white; background: var(--green); } .ds-citation:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-example { color: var(--ink); font: 14px/1.7 InterVariable, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Selected source passage
components.description: Full tonal selection with a thin inset outline.
components.html:
5:00 · Synthetic example

components.css: .ds-passage { padding: 20px 24px; background: var(--selected); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #91b3a3; color: var(--ink); font: 14px/1.7 InterVariable, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-passage strong { color: var(--green); font: 500 13px monospace; } .ds-passage p { margin: 8px 0 0; } .ds-passage:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Native disclosure
components.description: Secondary instructions stay available without JavaScript.

components.css: .ds-disclosure { color: var(--ink); border-block: 1px solid var(--line); font: 15px/1.6 InterVariable, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-disclosure summary { padding: 20px 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-disclosure summary:hover { color: var(--green); } .ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-disclosure p { color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 24px; }

narrative.overview: An open, precise review surface: readable evidence, visible annotations, and an explanation that does not lose its source. The user chose this direction for the website redesign. Bold condensed headings establish the larger narrative; the review itself is deliberately quieter and denser.
keyCharacteristics: Large condensed headlines, restrained evidence typography.
Open review columns and inspectable timestamp annotations.
Cool neutrals, deep green, and a pale lime adaptation surface.
Plain, legible controls with progressive enhancement.

rules.name: The Evidence State Rule
rules.body: Selected evidence uses a full tonal change and a thin inset outline, not a thick colored side stripe. Its corresponding citation also changes state.

rules.name: The Flat Review Rule
rules.body: Evidence gets no decorative elevation. Its selection outline communicates state, not a lifted card.

dos: Do keep source, interpretation, and adaptation visually distinguishable.
Do preserve exact source wording and visibly label synthetic demonstrations.
Do keep responsive visual and keyboard reading order aligned.
Do keep instructions usable without JavaScript.
donts: Don't substitute a filesystem mockup for a useful example.
Don't use false progress, fabricated testimonials, or a URL input that cannot process videos.
Don't turn source excerpts into a grid of decorative cards.
Don't use display typography for the dense evidence-reading role.
